messages:
Jia: Quick sync — Nebula joint perf sweep is scheduled for next Wed. Need to lock driver build, thermal-topology mapping, and a short smoke checklist before we hand over lab access. High-level ask: can we confirm driver SHA, PDU sampling cadence, and what telemetry tags partner will emit?

Leo: Do we have the driver SHA yet? Sarah, you mentioned uploading something.

Sarah: Uploaded driver v2 to S3 (s3://bench-artifacts/nebula/nebula-driver-v2.tar.gz). Artifact id nbdrv-v2-20260318. No kernel patch included, just a userspace driver so far. Partner also sent a short thermal map PDF.

Marc: PM note — runs are 2 days: day1 smoke + calibration, day2 12hr throughput runs. We need a concrete smoke checklist so on-site team can validate quickly. Who owns ingest for power logs?

Jia: I'll own the smoke checklist and prompt sets. Draft checklist below:
- verify driver unpack & checksum
- boot to target BIOS profile (nebula-default)
- PDU sampling at 1s
- start harness in canary mode (1 instance)
- run short perf sweep (seq=128/512) x3
- confirm prom metrics (p95_latency_ms, tokens/s, watts) visible

Jia: Quick run command for the harness (canary mode):
```
# run harness (example)
./run_sweep --model=redwood-3b --seq_len=512 --repeats=3 \
  --driver=s3://bench-artifacts/nebula/nebula-driver-v2.tar.gz \
  --telemetry=prom --canary
```

Jia: CSV header we want from the smoke: timestamp,model,seq_len,p95_latency_ms,tokens_per_sec,watts,gpu_util,driver_version

Leo: I'll add a small wrapper to upload PDU samples to the telemetry bucket. Plan: sample every 1s, tag with rack and unit, and attach a sha on upload. Also will run driver canary on staging nodes first.

Sarah: Partner sent thermal-topology and suggested fan presets; uploaded privately: https://nebula.example/thermal-map.pdf (NDAed). They asked that we set fans to "balanced" for smoke, "max-cool" for long-run.

bench-bot: artifact nbdrv-v2-20260318 scanned, checksum OK, size 14.2MB. Reminder: run canary for at least 10 minutes before full job.

Marc: Actions: Jia finalize checklist + prompt set by EOD Tue; Leo prepare telemetry wrapper + staging canary; Sarah confirm NDA & send partner access link; Marc will lock the calendar and ops rota.

Leo: I'll also include a small script snippet to convert PDU CSV to our canonical format: `python util/pdu_to_canon.py --input pdu.csv --out pdu_canon.csv --tag nebula-rack1`.

Sarah: Confirmed — will ping Nebula eng to drop the thermal mapping and fan presets to our shared bucket and confirm SSH jump host.

Jia: Perfect. One more thing — please set Prom scrape interval to 5s for the canary and 10s for long runs. Helps with correlation.

Marc: OK. I'll create the calendar invite and include partner contact + ops on-call. :thumbsup:

Jia: Thanks everyone. Short and focused on day1 smoke so we don't waste on-site time. :rocket:

Leo: +1

Sarah: +1

bench-bot: scheduled reminder: canary check at 2026-03-24T09:00Z.
